# State timeline (`state-timeline`)

When things were on, open or present over a day, as bars on a shared time axis.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createStateTimeline` (types in `dist/web/home/info/stateTimeline.d.ts`): `.mh-state-timeline`: one `__row` per thing in a `__rows` list, each with a `__label` (`__icon`, `__name`) and a `__track` holding `__span` bars (`--c1` to `--c6`, `.is-open-start`, `.is-open-end`; placed by `--_from` and `--_len`) and the `__now` line; under them a shared `__axis` (its `__scale` holds the `__tick`s). Each span's words ("On, 07:10 to 08:30") are its tooltip and its screen-reader text; the drawing itself is hidden from them.

```ts
export function createStateTimeline(options: StateTimelineOptions): StateTimelineHandle;

export interface StateTimelineOptions extends InfoClockFormat {
  rows: readonly StateTimelineRow[];
  /** The window shown on the axis. */
  start: InfoTime;
  end: InfoTime;
  /** The current time: open spans end here and a marker is drawn when it falls inside the window. */
  now?: InfoTime | null;
  /** About how many axis labels to aim for (default 4). */
  ticks?: number;
  /** Accessible name (default "Timeline"). */
  label?: string;
  labels?: Partial<StateTimelineLabels>;
}

export interface StateTimelineHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(changes: Partial<StateTimelineOptions>): void;
}

export interface StateTimelineLabels {
  /** Spoken between a span's start and end. */
  to: string;
  /** Spoken for a span that still holds ("until now"). */
  ongoing: string;
  /** Spoken for a span that began before the window. */
  before: string;
  /** Default state word. */
  on: string;
  /** Spoken for a row with no spans. */
  none: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiDoorOpen, mdiLightbulbOutline, mdiThermostat } from '@mdi/js';
import { createStateTimeline, type StateTimelineRow } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const today = (hours: number, minutes = 0): Date => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
  return d;
};

// A span with `to: null` is still going on.
const rows: StateTimelineRow[] = [
  {
    label: 'Hall light',
    icon: mdiLightbulbOutline,
    spans: [{ from: today(6, 40), to: today(7, 55) }, { from: today(17, 10), to: null }],
  },
  {
    label: 'Back door',
    icon: mdiDoorOpen,
    state: 'Open',
    color: 2,
    spans: [{ from: today(8, 5), to: today(8, 9) }, { from: today(12, 30), to: today(12, 52) }],
  },
  {
    label: 'Heating',
    icon: mdiThermostat,
    state: 'Heating',
    color: 5,
    spans: [{ from: today(5, 30), to: today(8, 30) }, { from: today(16, 30), to: null }],
  },
];

const timeline = createStateTimeline({
  label: 'Today at home',
  rows,
  start: today(0),
  end: today(24),
  now: Date.now(),
});

setInterval(() => timeline.update({ now: Date.now() }), 60_000);

document.body.append(timeline.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { mdiDoorOpen, mdiLightbulbOutline, mdiThermostat } from '@mdi/js';
import { StateTimeline } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { StateTimelineRow } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const today = (hours: number, minutes = 0): Date => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);
  return d;
};

// A span with `to: null` is still going on.
const rows: StateTimelineRow[] = [
  {
    label: 'Hall light',
    icon: mdiLightbulbOutline,
    spans: [{ from: today(6, 40), to: today(7, 55) }, { from: today(17, 10), to: null }],
  },
  { label: 'Back door', icon: mdiDoorOpen, color: 2, spans: [{ from: today(8, 5), to: today(8, 9) }] },
  { label: 'Heating', icon: mdiThermostat, color: 5, spans: [{ from: today(16, 30), to: null }] },
];

export function StateTimelineExample() {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());

  useEffect(() => {
    const tick = setInterval(() => setNow(Date.now()), 60_000);
    return () => clearInterval(tick);
  }, []);

  return <StateTimeline label="Today at home" rows={rows} start={today(0)} end={today(24)} now={now} />;
}
```
